title: RCPT TO acceptance validation removed: accepts any recipient address
description: The SMTP RCPT TO handler previously checked config.users to validate that each recipient was in the configured user list. The new code (crates/smtp/src/session.rs lines 392-437) accepts ANY recipient address without validation, returning 250 OK to any RCPT TO command. Combined with config.users being removed (no way to declare valid recipients), this allows relay abuse: any sender can submit mail for any recipient. Even though Sieve routing is single-user (_global), this violates the principle of explicit acceptance boundaries. Either: (a) restore config.users validation, or (b) explicitly document this is a public relay and remove the validation intentionally.
